newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schering - EU patent office halts rival drug patent.
newsitem.headline: Schering - EU patent office halts rival drug patent.

text.p: German drugs group Schering AG said on Wednesday that the European Patent Office had cancelled the patent allowing Schering's rival Biogen Inc to market the multiple sclerosis treatment Betaferon.
Schering said in a statement that it had been successful in having the so-called Fiers patent revoked after appealing to the European Patent Office.
The Fiers patent was introduced in 1990 and would have restricted Schering's production of the drug in Europe had the patent application been successful.
Schering said last month that it expected to reach sales of 590 million marks with Betaferon.
